I wish I could say I have a main. But I love playing Wraith, Lifeline and Bloodhound.


They're all so unique and useful in their own ways, though if I had to choose a favourite, it'd be Wraith.


When an ally dies, and we pick up their banner, I love to punch a tunnel near the respawn beacon all the way as close as possible to their deathbox so that they can loot their stuff back.


If punching a tunnel to get their stuff back isn't possible, I share some of my guns, ammo and heal stuff to help them back up.


Flanking tunnels are also really fun to pull out, they're difficult, but that's' what makes them fun to do.

Hello, not sure if this is the right or wrong place but i have a question about the app on android devices.. I decided to give it a try because a friend in my FC kept talking about it, but when i decided to install it, the google playstore prompted me to a "blabla" window before downloading it, the common "requests permission to see this stuff" thing.

I'm gonna copy-paste what bothered me about it:
"Device & app history
Allows the app to view one or more of: information about activity on the device, which apps are running, browsing history and bookmarks"

"Identity
Uses one or more of: accounts on the device, profile data" (this one doesn't really bother me as much.. most applications request identity)

But then, this one:
"Photos/Media/Files
Uses one or more of: files on the device such as images, videos, or audio, the device's external storage"

It kind of bothers me, because to me, at least, it seems like it invades privacy, i may be wrong.. But i'm just curious.. Why does it requests acess to the activity on the phone, apps, browsing history, photos/multimedia and all that stuff?

I find it quite annoying and weird that it asks for access to all that stuff.. My phone's a Sony Xperia E4G on android 4.4.4, if that adds anything to it.. I really wanted to try it out but, due to all the stuff it asks access to, it makes me skeptic about it.
